_comment: The truth lane (src/test/locale-figures.test.ts) fails the build when a locale string carries a digit that is neither a bound placeholder ({cartridges}) nor listed here. Every entry needs a reason. Counts, prices, percentages and multipliers about the product belong in generated data (COMMONS_STATS / TIER_FACTS), never here.

tokens.$9/mo: pro price copy — tulana owns prices; changing it is a ruling, not a regeneration
tokens.1: hyperCommons.shiftStat1 '1 file → ∞ objects' is a statement of what a hyperobject is
tokens.1,000: cdg.impactBody: rhetorical contrast ('more valuable than 1,000 cup holders'), not a claim
tokens.26.7mm: PCO 1881 thread outer diameter — spec data
tokens.4.25mm: involute gear reference dimension — spec data
tokens.3°: involute gear pressure-angle related spec data

patterns.reason: a bound placeholder filled from generated data
